name: zvideo_draw_noise_rect
description: zVid::DrawNoiseRect writes thresholded grayscale noise into the FX 16-bit surface over a supplied rectangle or the full FX surface.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the stack slot reused for the green-channel shift renders as the consumed intensity argument in HLIL.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x48d910 show the intensity < 1/256 early return, threshold = int(intensity * 256), optional rect/full-surface bounds, PixelPack_GetRgbBits, rand-based noise-table row offsets, and grayscale 16-bit pixel writes when the noise byte is below threshold.
Direct callees _ftol and zVideo::PixelPack_GetRgbBits are provider-backed or functional-equivalent; rand is an imported CRT provider call.
The native zVideo smoke verifies low-intensity no-op behavior, deterministic rand-offset row selection, rectangle bounds, 5:6:5 grayscale packing, and untouched pixels outside the rectangle.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x48d910 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
